summary: The tests now cover more playback and codec edge cases, including reordered HEVC video and audio in Matroska (MKV) files, AAC frame counting, and audio/video synchronization after seeking and resuming. They also exercise AV1 color metadata and keyframes, FFmpeg decoding, and color conversion between RGB, I420, and NV12 formats. Additional checks cover Android video-encoding limits and speech-recognition language negotiation, strengthening confidence across media playback and processing.
